subject: history
concept: Understanding that some things change over time while other things stay the same
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student compares an old and new version of a common object (like a phone or toy) and lists differences
exercise.pictorial: Student sorts pictures into 'has changed a lot' and 'stayed pretty much the same'
exercise.abstract: Student explains one way something has changed and one way something has stayed the same over time

misconception_flags: assumes everything from the past looked and worked identically to today

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
